account: The ITU entry, current to June 2025, describes a telecom foundation model, a transformer with 38 billion parameters. The model supports diagnosis, queries in natural language and optimization recommendations. It works within a system that also uses conventional network maps and routing methods. The entry lists a Huawei employee as a contact and Huawei as the only partner. It reports that with the AI-based system "the packet loss rate and network delay are significantly reduced" at MTN. It does not separate the contribution of the model and gives no effect size. The deployment setting is unclear because the entry describes both an MTN deployment and an internal testbed. On 13 November 2025 TechAfrica News relayed a joint announcement in which Huawei and MTN said that TM Forum had certified MTN South Africa's IP network at autonomous network Level 4. The assessment covered the handling of congestion and path interruption and awarded the highest grade in every dimension of the standard. The network runs Huawei's network digital map and network agent. The announcement gives no figures for packet loss or delay.
